title: The debt that killed Arthur Morgan in Red Dead 2
subject: arthur
description:
Could Arthur ever make up for it? 👇

The Thomas Downes debt and how it sealed Arthur Morgan's fate. Spoilers for Red Dead Redemption 2.

scenes.text: One ordinary debt became Arthur Morgan's death sentence.
The gang's moneylender, Strauss, sent him to collect from a sick farmer named Thomas Downes.
Arthur beat him for the money, and the dying man coughed right on him.
Months later, a doctor in Saint Denis gave Arthur the news: tuberculosis.
But that's not the darkest part. He found Thomas's widow and son broke and desperate in Annesburg.
So Arthur threw Strauss out of camp and helped young Archie escape the mines.
